description.en: The ID of the HSM instance.

description.zh: 要配置的白名单IP列表，多个IP之间用空格或半角逗号分隔。
description.en: The list of IP addresses to add to the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses with spaces or commas (,).

descriptions.zh: 未加入集群且状态为ACTIVE（已启用）的密码机实例可以配置白名单。
descriptions.en: You can configure the whitelist for an HSM instance if the instance has not joined a cluster and is in the Active status.
